messages.body:
<https://airflowsummit.org>

*Dear Apache Airflow Community,*


The Airflow Summit program is ready, this is the perfect time to start
planning your trip to Austin, take a look at the schedule and secure your
spot *while there are still free workshop spots & the Early Bird pricing is
still available. *

Full program <https://airflowsummit.org/program/>
<https://airflowsummit.org/sessions/2026/>

*Check out the featured workshops: *

Join this hands-on workshop by Kenten Danas, you’ll create a real *AI
pipeline
<https://www.linkedin.com/search/results/all/?keywords=%23aipipeline&origin=HASH_TAG_FROM_FEED>*
from scratch, no setup needed, and see how Airflow brings structure and
control to production AI.

Join this workshop to explore autonomous incident response, from real-time
root cause analysis to proactive issue prevention. Less noise. Faster
resolution. Smarter operations.

*Remember Early Bird tickets are available till the end of May!*


Get discounted ticket <https://airflowsummit.org/tickets/>


See you in Austin!

*The Airflow Summit Team*
